CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository maintains the **LXC** plugin for Unraid: a native WebGUI for running Linux Containers (LXC) alongside Docker, with directory, BTRFS and ZFS storage backends, scheduled snapshots and backups, an in-browser terminal, and cgroup v2 resource accounting.
The plugin ships its own LXC runtime packages, built from upstream LXC v7.0.0 with two backported command-socket hardening patches (GHSA-4xwm-pr6h-55r8) and published as version 7.0.1. Two runtimes are provided so older Unraid releases stay supported: `LXC-7.0.1-1.txz` (glibc 2.28 baseline, Unraid 6.10-6.12) and `LXC-7.0.1-2.txz` (glibc 2.36 baseline, Unraid 7.x).
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/moqiaoduo/unraid-lxc-plugin/issues
This is an independent community fork. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Unraid, Lime Technology, or the maintainers of the upstream LXC project.
